result.summary: Found 3 major layout issues: multiple content cards are visually cut off on the right and bottom edges of the page, preventing full visibility of restaurant information.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section (Trattoria Piccol) is horizontally cut off on the right edge - both the image and restaurant name are truncated
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container has proper overflow handling or adjust card sizing to fit within viewport without truncation

issues.description: The category filter buttons row has the rightmost button partially cut off, making it impossible to see or interact with the complete filter options
issues.suggestion: Implement horizontal scrolling for the filter buttons or adjust padding/margins to ensure all buttons are visible within the viewport

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card in 'Popular right now' section is vertically cut off, showing only the top portion of what appears to be a pizza restaurant card
issues.suggestion: Adjust container height constraints or implement proper vertical scrolling to ensure all content cards are fully visible and not clipped at the bottom
